svg.title: How revit-mcp makes a photoreal render
svg.desc: The Revit model is exported as glTF, Blender Cycles renders it with a sun placed from the model's latitude, date and time, and the picture comes back to the assistant. Everything runs on the same machine.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From a Revit model to a photoreal picture

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Revit cannot start its own ray tracer from outside, so the geometry leaves and the picture is made next door.

svg.text: Pick a mood (golden hour, overcast) or give an exact date. Draft takes about a minute; standard and final take longer.
